query:
UPDATE server_backups
            SET
                database_instance_uuid = $2,
                server_uuid = $3,
                node_uuid = $4,
                backup_group_uuid = $5,
                metadata = jsonb_set(server_backups.metadata, '{source_instance}', $6)
            WHERE
                server_backups.uuid = $1
                AND server_backups.deleted IS NULL
                AND server_backups.deleting IS NULL
